name: g2-crossbar
description: A cross-bar menu for Even Realities G2 glasses, inspired by the PSP's XrossMediaBar: watch and answer your coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kimi) running in tmux on your Mac, plus apps, projects, music, notes and a headline ticker.

scripts.pack: vite build --outDir dist-pack && mv dist-pack/crossbar.html dist-pack/index.html && evenhub pack app.json dist-pack -o crossbar.ehpk
